purpose: Completes the source-register field contract for SOURCE_REGISTER.json without inventing unavailable publication metadata. Join this file to SOURCE_REGISTER.json by source id. Evidence and model supplements already use the richer native schema and are not re-normalized here.

field_contract.title: SOURCE_REGISTER.json title
field_contract.date_version: per_source_metadata date_version; where the source itself did not expose a specific revision date during the research capture, the field says so and records the research check date rather than fabricating a publication date
field_contract.licensing_reuse: derived from SOURCE_REGISTER.json source_use according to licensing_profiles below
field_contract.limitations: derived from the source id's limitation_profile below

licensing_profiles.OPEN_PUBLIC_SECTOR_WITH_NOTICE_CHECK: Public-sector material used for factual/reference purposes. Check the page-specific copyright/reuse notice and any Open Government Licence conditions/exceptions before substantial reuse. No protected source prose is relied on by the candidate.
licensing_profiles.OPEN_OGL_SUBJECT_TO_EXCEPTIONS: Use may be available under the Open Government Licence subject to source-specific exceptions, attribution and third-party material. Candidate teaching is independently authored and does not depend on copying source prose.
licensing_profiles.REFERENCE_ONLY: Reference/fact-checking use only. No broad commercial reuse permission is assumed and no substantial source prose may enter generation.
licensing_profiles.REFERENCE_ONLY_UNTIL_ITEM_LICENCE_RECORD: Reference/fact-checking use only until the item-specific reuse licence is recorded. No substantial source prose may enter generation.
licensing_profiles.REFERENCE_ONLY_BOARD_ALIGNMENT: Qualification alignment/reference only. Protected specification wording is not a reusable prose substrate and must not organise board-independent subject truth.

PUBLIC_AUTHORITY_OR_LEGISLATION.limitations: Authoritative for the specific legal, regulatory or public-policy fact but not a complete Business curriculum. Rules, guidance and policy can change; current application must be re-verified when time-sensitive.

OFFICIAL_STATISTICS_OR_CENTRAL_BANK.limitations: Strong factual/methodological authority for the measured concept, but methodology may be more technical than Level 3 Business and does not by itself determine teaching scope or causal conclusions for a particular firm.

PROFESSIONAL_BODY.limitations: Professional-practice authority is useful for subject truth and application but can exceed Level 3 depth and is not a qualification specification. Reusable teaching must remain independently authored and bounded to the intended learner level.

INTERNATIONAL_RESEARCH_OR_PUBLIC_BODY.limitations: Provides high-quality comparative or research evidence but may not be UK-specific and can include specialist depth beyond a general UK Level 3 Business boundary. Transfer to the foundation requires contextual judgement.

FRAMEWORK_ORIGINATOR.limitations: Useful for establishing a named framework's provenance and intended purpose, not for treating the framework as objective or universally predictive subject truth. Assumptions and criticisms remain explicit in the model register.

AWARDING_BODY_POST_SEAL.limitations: Course-specific qualification evidence introduced only after the independent Phase 1 seal. It is used to test breadth/depth and identify deltas, never as the organising framework for the board-independent foundation and never as a prose source.
